title: API Development
seo: Custom API development for web and mobile apps
meta: Working API endpoints built, tested and deployed for your app or partners, with sign-in and docs. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Custom API development, endpoints your apps can use
overview: We build the backend endpoints your website, mobile app or partners need. You describe the data and actions, we write the API in a language that fits your stack, connect it to your database, add sign-in, test every route and deploy it to your hosting. You receive the code in your own repository, a short guide and sample calls so your team can keep going.

pkgs.blurb: A small, tested API with the endpoints you need first.
A fuller API with sign-in, paging and automated tests.
A production-ready API with logs, limits and handover docs.

faq: Which languages and databases do you work with?
We commonly build in Node.js, Python and PHP, with PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB. If you already have a stack, tell us and we match it so your team can maintain the result.
In your own hosting account, such as a cloud server, serverless platform or shared host you already pay for. We never keep the code on our side. You own the repository from day one.
Can you add to an API I already have?
Yes. Add us to your repository, tell us which endpoints are missing and we extend it in your existing style. We read the code first and confirm the scope in writing.
Is hosting included in the price?
No. Hosting and database fees are billed by your provider directly to you. Our price covers building, testing and deploying the API, plus the handover notes.
